questions.question: What did Nebuchadnezzar demand of his wise men in chapter 2?
options: To pay a very great tribute into the royal treasury
To leave Babylon and return to their own lands
To tell him both his dream and its interpretation
To set up a golden statue in the plain of Dura
questions.answer: To tell him both his dream and its interpretation

questions.question: What was the dream that Daniel revealed and interpreted?
options: Four great beasts rising out of the sea
A towering tree reaching up to the heavens
A great statue of metals struck by a stone
A river of fire flowing from a throne
questions.answer: A great statue of metals struck by a stone

questions.question: Daniel said the God of heaven would set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed.
